expectations.text: States all future-dated v4.x requirements became mandatory March 31, 2025 (v4.0.1 is the current standard)
expectations.evidence: "best practice until 31 March 2025... all of those previously future-dated requirements are fully in effect and must be assessed as mandatory" (refers to standard as v4.0, not contradicting v4.0.1)

expectations.text: Cites password/authentication changes: 12-character minimum passwords and MFA for ALL access into the CDE (8.3.6, 8.4.2)
expectations.evidence: "Minimum password length increased to 12 characters (up from 7)" (8.3.6); "8.4.2 — multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all access into the CDE... including from within the corporate network"

expectations.text: Cites e-commerce controls: payment page script inventory/authorization/integrity (6.4.3) and change-and-tamper detection (11.6.1)
expectations.evidence: "Requirement 6.4.3 — formal inventory of all scripts loaded on the payment page... Requirement 11.6.1 — change- and tamper-detection mechanism"

expectations.text: Mentions others such as automated log review mechanisms, authenticated internal vulnerability scans, and phishing protections
expectations.evidence: Mentions others: "5.4.1 — anti-phishing mechanisms", 10.7.x security-control-failure detection, 7.2.4 access reviews, targeted risk analysis 12.3.x

expectations.text: Advises a gap re-check for any assessment performed against pre-2025 practices
expectations.evidence: "if you haven't already done a gap assessment specifically against these formerly future-dated requirements, that should be the immediate priority"
